name: prompt-rail
description: A rail of your session's prompts beside the transcript or above the prompt; hover to read one, click to jump to it.

agentsViewFallback.title: AgentsView archive fallback
agentsViewFallback.description: When a clicked prompt is not loaded in the terminal, find the exact message through the local AgentsView CLI and open it in Google Chrome on macOS. No model call. Next/prev shortcuts stay terminal-only.

mode.title: Rail mode
mode.description: off: no rail. vertical: a pane beside the transcript, one row per prompt. horizontal: a row of bars above the prompt input (terminal only). /prompt-rail off|vertical|horizontal changes it too.
